summary: The psalm traces the sun across the sky; the other three passages use a turning point to mark elapsed time.

senses.definition: The sun sets out from one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to their other end.
The ingathering festival marks the turn of the year. The word also marks the passage of the days before Hannah bears Samuel and the return of the campaigning season.

note: The biblical contexts establish the spatial and temporal senses. They do not by themselves fix a technical astronomical date for the festival.
